primary.title: BlueStone Jewellery shares to be in focus on Tuesday as company turns profitable in Q1, revenue jumps 49%
primary.summary: BlueStone Jewellery reported a strong Q1FY27, with a 49% YoY increase in retail sales to ₹733 crore. The company also saw a 39% growth in same-store sales despite higher gold customs duties, and an improved EBITDA margin, reflecting strong operating leverage.
